'''Matcha Flavoured 1.12.5''', "Minor Bug Fixes", is a version of [[Matcha Flavoured]], published on October 10, 2026, five days after [[Matcha Flavoured 1.12.4|1.12.4]]. It is a second bug-fix patch for ''Minecraft'' 26.2, and the developer writes that it will be the last update for 26.2 unless a major game-breaking bug turns up, so that they can work on 26.3.<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.5|quote=This will be the last update for 26.2, unless there is some major game-breaking bug, I don't want to touch it. I want to work on 26.3}}</ref> Only the datapack changed; the resource pack of [[Matcha Flavoured 1.12.3|1.12.3]] is still current. The release notes ask builders to help with structures for the next update.<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.5|quote=If you want to help build structures for the new update come check out the Github "Builders wanted!" Issue.}}</ref>

1.12.5 was made from the pack's 26.2 branch and is the newest full release. The ''Minecraft'' 26.3 port continued on the repository's 26.3 branch and was released four days later as [[Matcha Flavoured 1.12.6-alpha|1.12.6-alpha]], an alpha for 26.3.

== Fixes ==
* [[Green Curry]], [[Japanese Curry]], [[Paneer Makhani]], [[Pumpkin Curry]] and [[Tonkotsu Ramen]] can no longer be cooked on a campfire ([[Kindling]]); their campfire recipes were removed.<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.5|quote=Ramen and Curries can no longer cooked on campfires}}</ref>
* The fishing junk table loads again (1.12.4 had a trailing comma in it), so [[Fishing junk|junk]] catches give items again, and the [[Frog|frog]], [[Tadpole|tadpole]] and [[Axolotl|axolotl]] can be fished.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/gameplay/fishing/junk.json}}</ref> The release notes add that this fix doesn't cover modded biomes.<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.5|quote=Fishing Junk LT Fixed (Not for modded biomes)}}</ref>
* [[Aura]] foods such as [[Glow Berry Mash]] work again. The advancements that start the aura required the food's custom data to be exactly the aura marker, which stopped matching once 1.12.4 added a version number to the custom data of newly made items; they now only check that the marker is there.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/mechanics/aura_effect/3s.json}}</ref><ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.5|quote=Glow Berry Jam and Mash fixed}}</ref>
* The [[Updating items|item updater]] no longer turns ordinary items into pack items: holding any book turned it into an [[Angler's Almanac]], any shield into a [[Warding Shield|warding shield]] and any bow into a [[Compound Bow|compound bow]]. The updater's checks for these three items accepted the plain base item. The fix is partial for all three: a plain book, shield or bow in the off hand still makes the updater turn a plain one in the main hand into the pack item (see [[Known bugs]]).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha_item/advancement/trigger/anglers_almanac.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha_item/predicate/offhand/anglers_almanac.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha_item/advancement/trigger/compound_bow.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha_item/advancement/trigger/warding_shield.json}}</ref><ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.5|quote=Books no longer turn into angler's almanacs}}</ref>
* Foxes drop [[Fox Pelt|fox pelts]] and [[Raw Flesh|raw flesh]] again: the fox loot table, which 1.12.4 broke, can be loaded.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/entities/fox.json}}</ref><ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.5|quote=Fox Pelts actually fixed}}</ref>
* The village chest loot tables name their bread, apple and sweet berry loot tables at the folder those moved to before 1.12.3; since then those entries had given nothing. The pack's [[abandoned village]]s have no loot-table chests, so this changes nothing in a new world. See [[Chest loot#Village]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/chests/village/village_plains_house.json}}</ref>
* The release notes also list "various earring bugs" without saying what they were; no file about earrings differs between the 1.12.4 and 1.12.5 releases.<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.5|quote=Various earring bugs patched (Im not telling you what they were)}}</ref>

The release notes add that updating to 1.12.5 doesn't show the "New player has been updated" message, and that this is intentional.<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.5|quote=When you update you will NOT get a message saying "New player has been updated"}}</ref>

== Bugs ==
* Now that the junk table loads, its [[Fish Bones|fish bones]] come from the loot table that builds them on an ender pearl, so fished fish bones can be thrown and don't work as bones. See [[Known bugs]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/materials/fish_bones.json}}</ref>
* Plain books, shields and bows can still become Angler's Almanacs, warding shields and compound bows through the off-hand check (above).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha_item/predicate/mainhand/anglers_almanac.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha_item/predicate/mainhand/warding_shield.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha_item/predicate/mainhand/compound_bow.json}}</ref>
